titre: Les rentes à rendement indexé battent chaque année un record
sous_titre: Ventes annuelles de rentes à rendement indexé (RILA) aux États-Unis, en Mds $, de 2022 à 2025

series.nom: Ventes de rentes RILA aux États-Unis

2022.texte: total RILA sales reached $41.1 billion in 2022, 6% higher than prior year

2023.texte: Total RILA sales reached $47.4 billion in 2023, 15% higher than prior year

2024.texte: RILA sales reached $65.6 billion in 2024, 38% higher than the prior year.

2025.texte: In 2025, RILA sales increased 20% year over year to $79.5 billion.
